description: This file contains the AppIdentityDbContextSeed class, which provides an asynchronous method to seed initial data into the identity database. It sets up roles and default users for an ASP.NET Core Identity-based authentication system.

classes.name: AppIdentityDbContextSeed
classes.description: Provides methods to seed initial identity data such as roles and default users into the database.

methods.name: SeedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously seeds roles and default users into the identity database, establishing initial configuration for user roles and credentials.
